items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Garvin Bushell had just left. Bushell had got fired, and they got Jeff a week before I joined the band.

ctx.x: That was the first band to hit the Cotton Club downtown. The only man I would question would be Jerry Blake. Let's see, now. There was Hilton Jefferson, who had just joined the band... He joined the band a week before I did, because Garvin Bushell had just left. Bushell had got fired, and they got Jeff a week before I joined the band. So there was Hilton Jefferson, Walter Thomas, Andrew Brown...
We had another guy on baritone. I can't think of his name now.
